content: it-tools.tech (CorentinTh/it-tools) is the closest developer-catalog competitor: client-side, Markdown to HTML, Text diff, SQL prettify, Case converter, Slugify, Token generator + password strength, Lorem ipsum, Text statistics, QR + WiFi QR. No dedicated SQL dialect kitchen sink. Camera recorder exists separately; WiFi QR is extra. Catalog UX is one-job tools, live, copy.
